name: spawn_and_select_object

stack.evidence: func_001D3138 consumes one object ID, passes it to func_001245F0, and refreshes the selected-object pointer from the Script-bound object ID

notes: func_001245F0 resolves the encoded object ID to its resource record, allocates and initializes a live object, and returns the new object. func_001D3138 then refreshes Script offset 0x04 through func_00123880, making that object the selected object for subsequent commands. The JP corpus contains 416 calls.
